name: Henry Russell
title: Software and Systems Engineer

pages.text: Software engineer at Zühlke, an engineering consultancy, since 2022, building TypeScript, React and Vue applications for banking, payments and Co-op clients, with Python and AWS behind them. One of two developers on Barclaycard Payments’ live marketing site; delivered the front end of an LLM mortgage chatbot in 10 days. Sole developer of Yomu, a Japanese reading product built with AI coding agents inside automated tests and delivery checks.

React, Next.js, Vue, web components, micro-frontends, component libraries, Contentful

pages.title: Advanced Software Engineer
pages.org: Zühlke Engineering, London · Professional Software Engineer: Sep 2022 – Jan 2024

items: Built the live marketing site for Barclaycard Payments, a business processing 9 billion transactions a year, in Next.js, React and TypeScript in a team of 2.
With content editors, helped define the Contentful content model and built reusable page templates.
Integrated Salesforce and a pricing API into the site’s customer journeys.

pages.name: Co-op Funeralcare · the UK’s largest funeral services provider · coop.co.uk/funeralcare
pages.tech: Vue, TypeScript, Python, Django, AWS, Contentful, Adobe Target

items: Delivered a new funeral home finder app during a code-freeze incident.
Built Vue and TypeScript micro-frontends and Contentful/Jinja HTML templates for customer journeys including Direct Cremation and the funeral home finder.
Created a shared component library with web component support.
Implemented A/B tests in Adobe Target and contributed to Python/Django services, AWS integrations and monitoring.

pages.name: PostFinance · mortgage chatbot for a Swiss bank

items: Built the Vue and TypeScript front end for an LLM mortgage chatbot on AWS Bedrock.
Delivered it in a 10-day window, structured for the client to extend.

pages.name: Handelsbanken · mortgage application platform for a regulated bank
pages.tech: React, TypeScript, React Testing Library, Java, TDD, SAFe

items: Developed regulated mortgage application journeys in React and TypeScript, including custom routing, state management, validation and debounced autosave.
Practised TDD and pair programming, tested with React Testing Library, and collaborated closely with QA in a shift-left workflow.
Integrated with internal banking systems for document generation and data services.
Taught A-level Computer Science one to one: lesson planning, core topics and coursework feedback.
Led development of a student module-selection web platform integrated with university systems and used by students.

pages.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
pages.org: Royal Holloway, University of London · first-year programming labs and coursework marking

pages.name: Yomu · Japanese reading tool · yomureader.com · github.com/HRussellZFAC023/yomu-reader
pages.tech: TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Stripe, Playwright, Electron, GitHub Actions · May 2026 – Present

items: Sole developer of Yomu, a popup dictionary with OCR and subtitle mining for reading Japanese on websites, manga, PDFs and video. It ships as Chrome and Firefox extensions, a desktop app and a PWA.
Runs on 5 Cloudflare Workers with SQL databases, Google sign-in and Stripe Checkout. A probe checks production every 30 minutes, and a test fails if any route lacks a health check.
Published 526 releases in 6 months. The 12-job GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline includes type checks, 1,100+ test files and Playwright smoke tests.

Built with AI agents (Codex and Claude Code) kept in check by written rules (AGENTS.md), a dead-code check that fails only on new findings, a Codex MCP bridge and 30 architecture decision records in Git.
Designed the interface and theme system: colour tokens, themes that adapt to the host site, a radial menu, reduced-motion support and automated accessibility checks with axe-core.
Built a web app (React, Tailwind CSS), Node.js CLI and API that turn a JavaScript userscript into browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox and Safari. 21 GitHub stars; Yomu’s build depends on it.

pages.name: In-browser speech-to-text and semantic search · Vue 3, TypeScript, Transformers.js, WebGPU

items: Built, with AI coding agents, Japanese speech-to-text that runs entirely in the browser (Whisper on WebGPU), and semantic search over catalogue titles using embeddings, in a toolkit with 223 test files.

pages.text: VisualNav, a team project with Intel and Microsoft: a Visual Studio extension for coding by face movement and speech, for developers with motor impairments. Wrote 285 of 534 commits and the Microsoft Educator Developer Blog write-up.
